title: Grateful Dead Live at Auditorium Theatre on 1971-08-23
lineage: AUD > MR > Cass > Reel > DAT > CD > SHN

ai_review.summary: Almost unlistenable low‑fidelity recording of an otherwise decent show that includes the first "Brown Eyed Women" and a Cryptical → Wharf Rat segment.
ai_review.review: The performance itself is regarded as solid – fans note the early appearance of “Brown Eyed Women” and the Cryptical into Wharf Rat sequence – but the tape quality is described as cheap, muffled and often unlistenable. The recording appears to be a partial audience capture with severe fidelity problems that overwhelm the music.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently condemn the audio as poor or unlistenable, while a few acknowledge the show’s musical merit; weighted average of strong negative recording feedback and modestly positive show comments yields a low‑mid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as recorded with a cheap tape player/mic, muffled, weak, and often unlistenable; appears to be an incomplete partial capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Partial set; missing several expected tracks (e.g., China Cat, I Know You Rider, Truckin', Sugaree) leading to confusion about the full show order.
